definition: Yejin Choi (Korean: 최예진; born 1977) is the Dieter Schwarz Foundation Professor and Senior Fellow at the Department of Computer Science at Stanford University and the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence (HAI) respectively.
details: Her research considers natural language processing and computer vision.

explainer.lead: Yejin Choi is a South Korean computer scientist (born 1977). Her work spans computational linguistics and artificial intelligence.
explainer.knownFor: She started to assemble a knowledge base that became known as the atlas of machine commonsense (ATOMIC).

contributions.name: At Stony Brook University Choi developed a statistical technique to identify fake hotel reviews.
She has developed computational models that can detect biases in language that work against people from underrepresented groups.

timeline.what: In 2018 Choi joined the Allen Institute for AI.
In 2020, Choi was endowed with the Brett Helsel Professorship, which she held until she became Chair of Computer Science in 2023.
In 2023, Choi became The Wissner-Slivka Chair of Computer Science.
